india_trends.title: Praj Industries shares rally 7% after Q1 profit more than doubles YoY
india_trends.summary: Praj Industries shares surged 6.5% after Q1FY27 net profit more than doubled year-on-year to Rs 12 crore, while revenue rose 12% to Rs 716 crore. The company reported Rs 1,000 crore in order intake and ended the quarter with an order backlog of Rs 4,589 crore, providing strong execution visibility.

india_trends.title: Reddit gets S&P 500 boost: What investors need to know
india_trends.summary: Reddit shares surged around 11% in after-hours trading after the social media company was selected to join the S&P 500 from August 18. The inclusion is expected to trigger passive-fund buying, while investors continue to track advertising growth, user engagement and AI-related traffic risks.

india_trends.title: Jefferies’ Chris Wood spots a hidden risk in Big Tech’s $165 billion AI capex race
india_trends.summary: Big Tech’s AI capex surge is putting pressure on free cash flow, with Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta spending $165 billion in Q2 against just $7 billion in free cash flow. Jefferies’ Chris Wood warns that growing reliance on cash-burning AI firms OpenAI and Anthropic could pose a hidden risk.
